Thanks — I appreciate you reaching out and I’m glad the React work caught your eye. The project scope you outlined (real-time charts, REST API integration, auth/role-based access, responsive + dark mode) is right in my wheelhouse.

Before we schedule a call, could you confirm a few details so I can prepare:

- Target browsers / devices and any accessibility requirements

Your posted budget of $5,000–$6,000 and ~4 week timeline is reasonable depending on final scope. I’m available to start in early next month and can do a 30–45 minute call this week to align on requirements — my availability is Tue/Wed afternoons (CT) or Thu morning. Please let me know a time that works or send a calendar invite.

I can share relevant portfolio links and references during the call. Looking forward to hearing more and discussing next steps.

Best,
